name: style-skill-from-refs
title_zh: 参考图进，风格技能出：自带校验器的设计系统提取器
tagline_zh: 丢一文件夹参考图，拿回一个能直接用的风格技能——含可机读设计系统目录、提示词编译器、校验器和评测集。
tagline_en: Drop a folder of reference images, get a ready-to-use style skill with machine-readable design catalogs, prompt.
desc_en: Turn a folder of reference images into a complete, self-contained image-generation style skill with machine-readable design-system catalogs, a prompt compiler, a validator and evals. Use when the user says 从参考图生成 skill, 把这些图做成风格 skill, 用这些参考图提取设计系统, 做一个风格 skill, build a style skill from these references, extract a design system from images, make a skill out of these reference images, turn this moo
why_zh: 它把「看图说话」变成「可测试的工程」：设计系统是结构化目录而非玄学描述，编译器保证输出一致。
why_en: Turns 'vibe from images' into testable engineering: design system as structured catalog, compiler for consistent output.
limit_zh: 只吃图片文件夹，不吃单张图；产物是风格技能包而非成品图；需要用户已有可运行该技能的宿主环境。
limit_en: Takes folders only, not single images; outputs a skill package, not finished images; needs a host runtime; weak on abstract art or typography-only.
title_en: Reference images in, style skill out: design-system.
